findings.text: follow-on: the declared report directory was left empty -- no report artifact was written there, so a reader following the declared write scope (as the sibling population nodes' population-report.md invites) finds nothing; the answer exists only in manifest.md.

follow-on: the pre-flight guard's inline summary regex is a second spelling of the owned reckon/crew/review.py:1301 _PYTEST_SUMMARY_RE, so a log the owner's _gate_log_format accepts by its FAILED-line pattern can be refused here -- the guard and the reader can disagree.

follow-on: the supplied population list names tests/conftest.py and tests/spa_parity_harness.py, which pytest collects as test modules, producing the spurious collection ERROR tests/conftest.py::test_temp_config_home (fixture 'prefix' not found); it is identical at both arms so the differential is unaffected, but it inflates the error count a reader sees.

item_verdicts.diff: the reviewed node committed nothing (its worktree HEAD is the dispatch base 69bc6118 and is clean), so the diff base-to-head is empty; I read the delivered artifacts instead -- arm-base.log, arm-cand.log, derive.log, diag.log, main-check.log, slurm-1288391.out and measure-population.sbatch.
item_verdicts.done_when: the FENCE-EVIDENCE names two logs over one exclusive all_debug job that each carry rev=/host/command, prove reckon.__file__ under their own checkout, carry pytest's summary line and EXIT=, with added ids derived by reckon.crew.review.added_failures_from_gate_logs and alone runs for any added id; arm-base.log:1-5 and arm-cand.log:1-5 carry those headers and EXIT=1 footers, the derivation returns 0 with a positive control, and added ids 0 leaves nothing to run alone.
item_verdicts.goal: the reviewed node's goal is to measure the watch-stream and roadmap importer population of the single stream parse at base 763444a27fb5c87ab63032c8d5e3e12fe972f70c and at the candidate 220d0645f56af56f830479963851af5b436f2b9c on an exclusive node; the delivered manifest answers it (added ids 0) from one exclusive all_debug job 1288391 (slurm-1288391.out:1-5, both arms EXIT=1).
item_verdicts.manifest: read; manifest.md records status complete, each arm's pass/fail counts with its log path, added ids 0, both revisions, and baseline_suite/after_suite carrying the same four pre-existing failure ids.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared write path is the report directory reports/reckon/a-read-answers-inside-its-deadline/watch-stream-once-population-at-merge, which is empty; every artifact is an arm log, diag log, main-check log or script under the run directory the delivery fence names for logs, and no path under reckon/ or tests/ changed (the reviewed worktree is clean at 69bc6118).

justifications.durability: the node adds no test of its own, so its added-ids-0 claim rests on the owned reader reckon/crew/review.py:2114, which three existing tests cover (e.g. tests/test_a_ctest_gate_log_is_read.py) and which I falsified with a synthetic head FAILED line.
justifications.evidence: arm-base.log:1-5 and arm-cand.log:1-5 carry rev=/host=/cwd=/module=/command= headers with EXIT=1 footers, and I reproduced the derivation (0, []) plus its positive control (an injected head FAILED line returns 1, a base one 0).
justifications.fit: measure-population.sbatch and manifest.md carry no plan label, ticket number or version in any symbol, path or comment.
justifications.goal_fidelity: manifest.md answers the brief's question with both arms' counts and added ids 0, run as one exclusive all_debug job on 98dci4-clu-3141 (slurm-1288391.out:1).
justifications.reuse: measure-population.sbatch:98 calls the owner reckon/crew/review.py:2114 added_failures_from_gate_logs rather than diffing FAILED lines by hand, though its pre-flight summary check at line 90 is a second spelling of the owner's _PYTEST_SUMMARY_RE.
justifications.scope_discipline: no path under reckon/ or tests/ changed (the reviewed worktree is clean at 69bc6118), and every write is a run-directory log/script or node-local scratch the job's EXIT/TERM/INT trap sweeps.
